lines: 退籍状拍在桌上的时候，沈照夜怀里只剩半包冷掉的药渣。
韩松坐在杂役堂上首，手指按着那张薄纸，指甲在“沈照夜”三个字上敲了两下。
“签了。”
沈照夜没有动。
屋外下着细雨，青岳剑院的石阶被冲得发黑。杂役堂里站着十几个人，都是来看热闹的。有人抱剑，有人揣手，更多人的目光落在沈照夜背后的旧布条上。
布条里裹着一柄断剑。
那是他父亲沈长庚留下的剑，剑名照夜。
韩松把笔推到他面前。
“签了退籍状，把剑留下。药铺那边，我还能给你妹妹批三天药。”
沈照夜抬眼：“三天之后呢？”
韩松笑了一声。
“三天之后，你已经不是青岳剑院的人。一个废骨杂役的妹妹，剑院养不起。”
屋里有人低笑。
沈照夜听得见。
这三年，他在测骨石前站过九次。每一次，石头都是暗的。别人十六岁入外院，十七岁练剑气，他十七岁还在杂役堂劈柴、扫雪、清废剑冢。
剑院没有赶他，是因为沈长庚当年在青岳剑院留过名。
现在，那点旧名也不够用了。
韩松靠回椅背，声音淡下来。
“裴家那边已经补了名额。你这个位置，今天必须空出来。”
退籍状上写得很干净。
自愿退籍。
自愿交还剑院所发一应兵器。
自愿结清药铺旧账。
每个字都像磨好的刀。
沈照夜说：“照夜不是剑院的剑。”
韩松眯眼：“你说不是就不是？”
“我父亲留下的。”
“沈长庚？”韩松嗤笑，“他若真有本事，就不会死在春秋关，还连累你在剑院当三年杂役。”
沈照夜的手指慢慢收紧。
他没有说话。
今天不是为了争这句话。
沈霜还在西偏院等药。
昨夜小丫头咳了一整夜，后半夜咳出的血点被她悄悄藏进席子底下。她以为沈照夜没看见，天亮时还笑着说：“哥，我好多了。”
她的嘴唇白得没有一点血色。
沈照夜先去了药铺。
药铺管事连柜门都没开。
“韩执事发话了。”管事坐在柜台后拨算盘，“从今日起，你们兄妹的赊药条作废。”
沈照夜说：“上个月还差七钱银子，我可以去黑石矿栈做夜工。”
“夜工名额也满了。”
content_en:
When the certificate of withdrawal was slapped on the table, Shen Zhaoye only had half a pack of cold medicine residue left in his arms.
Han Song sat at the top of the handyman hall, pressing his fingers on the thin paper and tapping his nails twice on the words "Shen Zhaoye".
"Signed."
Shen Zhaoye didn't move.
It was drizzling outside the house, and the stone steps of Qingyue Sword Academy were washed black. There were more than a dozen people standing in the handyman hall, all coming to watch the fun. Some people were holding swords, others were holding their hands, and more people's eyes fell on the old cloth strip behind Shen Zhaoye.
Wrapped in the cloth was a broken sword.
It was the sword left by his father Shen Changgeng, and the sword was named Zhaoye.
Han Song pushed the pen in front of him.
"Sign the certificate of withdrawal and keep the sword. Over at the drug store, I can still approve medicine for your sister for three days."
Shen Zhaoye raised his eyes: "What about three days later?"
Han Song laughed.
"Three days later, you will no longer be a member of the Qingyue Sword Academy. The Sword Academy cannot afford to support the sister of a useless handyman."
Someone in the room chuckled.
Shen Zhaoye could hear it.
In the past three years, he has stood in front of the bone measuring stone nine times. Each time, the stone was dark. Others entered the outer courtyard at the age of sixteen and practiced swordsmanship at the age of seventeen. At the age of seventeen, he was still chopping firewood, sweeping snow, and clearing the sword tomb in the handyman hall.
The Sword Academy did not expel him because Shen Changgeng had left a name in Qingyue Sword Academy back then.
Now, the old name is no longer enough.
Han Song leaned back in his chair and his voice softened.
"The Pei family has filled up the quota. Your position must be vacant today."
The deregistration certificate is written clearly.
Voluntary withdrawal from membership.
Voluntarily hand over a weapon issued by the sword academy.
Voluntarily settle old accounts at drug stores.
Every word is like a sharpened knife.
Shen Zhaoye said: "Zhaoye is not the sword of the Sword Academy."
Han Song narrowed his eyes: "You said it's not the case?"
"My father left it behind."
"Shen Changgeng?" Han Song sneered, "If he was really capable, he wouldn't have died at Chunqiu Pass, and would have forced you to work as a handyman in the Sword Academy for three years."
Shen Zhaoye's fingers slowly tightened.
He didn't speak.
Today is not about arguing about this sentence.
Shen Shuang is still waiting for medicine in the West Branch Hospital.
The little girl coughed all night last night, and the blood she coughed up in the second half of the night was secretly hidden under the mat. She thought Shen Zhaoye hadn't seen it, so she smiled and said at dawn, "Brother, I'm much better."
Her lips were so white that there was no blood at all.
Shen Zhaoye went to the drug store first.
The drug store manager didn't even open the cabinet door.
"Deacon Han has spoken." The steward sat behind the counter and dialed the abacus, "From today on, your brother and sister's credit slips will be invalid."
Shen Zhaoye said: "I still have seven silver coins left last month. I can go to the Black Stone Mine to work at night."
"The night job quota is also full."
